lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, approximately circular pixel clusters arranged in multiple horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank, originating posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a visible grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A clear horizontal linear feature situated on the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient transition from higher luminance above to lower luminance below.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin demonstrates a significantly higher density of smaller, uniform high-luminance spots compared to the larger, more widely spaced clusters on the lateral flank.
